productionDate.original: 东汉灵帝建宁四年（171）六月十三日
productionDate.note: The source gives a day; the date model stores months, so the day stays in the original wording.

currentCollection.note: The county page places the inscription on the cliff at 青龙头 in 西狭, about 13 km west of Cheng County town, and states that it remains there. No shelter, fence or visiting arrangement is described.
currentCollection.noteZh: 成县页面记摩崖在成县县城以西约 13 公里的西狭青龙头崖壁，且仍在原址。页面没有说明碑亭、围栏或参观安排。

review.note: Draft object record from a county government page read on 2026-11-18. No measured dimensions, condition survey or protection file is cited; the cliff was not examined.
review.noteZh: 草稿实物记录，依据 2026-11-18 阅读的县政府页面整理。未引用实测尺寸、保存状况调查或保护档案；未实地核对。

notes: The page says the text survives intact, but it is a general description, not a condition survey.
No dimension is stored: the cited page gives none.
The cliff face is the object. It has not been cut down or moved, so there is no accession history to record.
notesZh: 页面称碑文完好，但属概述，不是保存状况调查。
未填尺寸：所引页面没有给出。
摩崖本身即实物，未凿移，故没有入藏经过可记。
